note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row moved to {gap} under the owner ruling that RTR version 0 is owed. RFC 6810 Section 6.1 reads 'To limit the length of time a cache must keep the data necessary to generate incremental updates, a router MUST send either a Serial Query or a Reset Query no less frequently than once an hour.' The Serial and Reset Queries this binds are version 0 PDUs, and Ze sends none: RTRSession starts at rtrVersionMax, RTRSession.syncOnce bounds the downgrade loop at rtrVersionMin = 1, and internal/component/bgp/plugins/rpki/rtr_session.go::RTRSession.handlePDU refuses a cache's Error Report code 4 that offers a version below rtrVersionMin and any data PDU below it, so a version 0 cache never gets a session to poll. The periodic re-query on the Refresh and Retry Intervals (cacheGroup.Run, pollDelay) runs only in version 1 and 2 sessions and is proven under RFC8210-8.1-1; RFC 8210 also replaces the fixed hour with the cache-signalled Refresh Interval. No version 0 path exists, so the requirement is unmet.
